_scenario: One moving target in R^3. Three quadrotors are pinned to it through identity maps, each with a formation offset placing it at a vertex of an equilateral triangle CENTERED on the target -- so the whole triangle translates with the target in x, y and z. A ground robot is pinned through PROJECT_XY and shadows the target's ground track directly beneath the triangle's centroid. The consensus edges hold the triangle rigid; the pinning edges drag it around.

safety._min_separation_note: CBF safety filter radii [m]. air_air is measured in R^3, the two radii involving a rover horizontally only (a quadrotor at 1.4 m cannot hit a rover however close their ground tracks are). alpha is the class-K gain in hdot >= -alpha h. Sized against this scenario: the triangle side is 2.08 m and the rover sits 1.2 m horizontally from each quadrotor, so once the formation is assembled nothing is near a constraint and the filter is inert (bit-identical trajectory from t = 30 s). It exists for the transients: on the way to its slot the rover passed 0.970 m horizontally from uav1, inside a radius of this bound, and with the filter that approach becomes 1.001 m.

_pinning_note: map names the restriction R^3 -> edge stalk applied to BOTH endpoints. 'xy' is the R^2 ground projection, 'z' the R^1 altitude projection, 'identity' all of R^3. This is the whole scenario in four lines.

gains._note: Sized for stability through the physical inner loop, not tracking speed: target motion is carried by velocity feedforward, so the gradient only assembles the formation and rejects disturbance. k*lambda_max(L) must clear ~0.5 s of PX4 velocity-loop lag plus tick latency.

mocap._source_note: 'sim' republishes Gazebo ground truth (sheaf_ros2 mocap_bridge). 'natnet' talks to the park's OptiTrack/Motive over NatNet (sheaf_ros2 mocap_natnet). The launch file starts exactly one of them, because two publishers on the same pose_topic interleave silently.
mocap._park_note: At the park: server = the Motive machine's address, local = the address of the interface on THIS host that can reach it (Motive answers only the interface it is bound to), up_axis = whatever Motive's Streaming pane says. Set multicast to "" for unicast streaming. Per agent, mocap_body names the rigid body in Motive (defaults to the agent name) and mocap_id pins its streaming id if the take's assets cannot be discovered by name.

_mocap_note: pose_topic makes each adapter take world-frame truth instead of its own estimator. In simulation that truth is Gazebo's, republished by sheaf_ros2's mocap_node; at the Autonomy Park it is OptiTrack, and only the publisher changes. Without it the rover runs on wheel dead-reckoning (it cannot even see itself being dragged) and each quadrotor's frame is anchored wherever it booted.
_formation_note: Offsets sum to zero, so the triangle's centroid IS the target and the rover sits directly beneath it. Side length r*sqrt(3) = 2.08 m. All three quadrotors fly the target's altitude; separation comes from the triangle itself, and the pad-to-slot transits are short because the spawns roughly face their vertices.
